slot.brief: Decompose a proper rational function (distinct linear factors) into partial fractions and integrate each term.

verdicts.working: Partial fractions: (3x+5)/((x+1)(x+2)) = 2/(x+1) + 1/(x+2). Integrating from 0 to 1 gives [2 ln(x+1) + ln(x+2)]_0^1 = ln 6.

working:
$\dfrac{3x+5}{(x+1)(x+2)}=\dfrac{2}{x+1}+\dfrac{1}{x+2}$.\n$\int_0^1\left(\dfrac{2}{x+1}+\dfrac{1}{x+2}\right)dx=2\ln 2+\ln\dfrac{3}{2}=\ln 6$.

Independent check: Partial fractions: (3x+5)/((x+1)(x+2)) = 2/(x+1) + 1/(x+2). Integrating from 0 to 1 gives [2 ln(x+1) + ln(x+2)]_0^1 = ln 6.
